confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and beer anchors use Bali's latest aggregated cost-of-living prices. Cocktail and wine-glass prices are estimated at about three and two times local draft beer, respectively, because a comparable current local average was not established. Accommodation is a holistic estimate with substantial variation across Ubud, Canggu, season, and property; no live booking listings were consulted.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single city comparator was used; accommodation estimates reflect the tourist-oriented Ubud/Canggu market within a broad Southeast Asian island-destination range.
